units.source_text: 船舱里的煤油灯熄灭了。

en.t: The kerosene lamp in the cabin went out.

units.source_text: 船上的生鱼味和潮水味变得更加浓重。

en.t: The smell of raw fish and the scent of the tide on the boat grew even stronger.

units.source_text: 在黑暗中，少年的体温温暖着我。

en.t: In the darkness, the boy's body warmth was warming me.
I let the spring of tears pour out.

units.source_text: 我的头脑恍如变成了一池清水，一滴滴溢了出来，后来什么都没有留下，顿时觉得舒畅了。

en.t: It was as if my mind had become a pool of clear water, overflowing drop by drop, until at last nothing remained, and suddenly I felt at ease.
